maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring OOMs in shard-B during prefix-heavy bursts. Need short-term owners + rollback-safe plan.

omar: I can own immediate mitigations. Plan: add soft per-shard memory cap + lightweight LRU eviction toggle.

ravi: I'll own allocator/profiling work. Will enable jemalloc stats and heap pprof captures on suspect nodes.

kyle: I'll automate profile collection and upload to S3. Also add a dashboard for canary metrics.

omar: Proposed canary: us-west-2 only, 10% traffic with soft cap + eviction. Rollout 10->30->100% with 6h observation windows.

maya: Timeline: PR for soft cap + toggle in 24h, canary deploy in 48h, profiling window 48-96h.

ravi: Suggest jemalloc MALLOC_CONF=decay_time:1 behind env toggle on canary. Also capture slab stats every 5m.

kyle: Checklist I'll use during rollout: 1) deploy canary 10% 2) monitor 15m 95p latency and OOMs 3) rollback if OOMs spike or errors >2x 4) collect profiles to s3://redwood-oom/2150007777/

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary created: route=shard-B-canary, capacity=10%, owner=omar, creator=maya, id=canary-2150007777.

omar: I'll include a rollback flag and annotated rollout steps in the PR.

maya: Long-term tracking ticket needed for GC tuning, slab sizing, and KV refactor. I'll open after canary. Provisional owners: ravi (allocator), kyle (observability), omar (runtime).

kyle: Kicking off first profile job now; will post S3 path once upload completes.

maya: Thanks — reconvene in this thread after first 24h of data. If anyone hits blocking issues, ping @here. :thumbsup:
